title: Florida House, District 88
what_it_does: Represents District 88 (Part of Palm Beach) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.

candidates.background: William Joseph, 55, has lived in the district for more than 30 years, owns and has operated several local businesses, and is licensed as a professional investigator and fugitive agent. He has served on three boards in Lake Worth Beach and is married with three children.

candidates.name: Jervonte Edmonds
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: CEO and founder of Suits for Seniors (nonprofit); realtor; state representative since 2022
candidates.background: Jervonte 'Tae' Edmonds earned a political science degree from Florida Atlantic University, founded the nonprofit Suits for Seniors and works as a realtor. He won a March 2022 special election for District 88 and has been re-elected since; he is the Democratic ranking member on a House health subcommittee and lives in West Palm Beach.

abortion.summary: Voted no on SB 300 (2023), which limited most abortions to six weeks of pregnancy, on April 13, 2023.

veterans.summary: He sponsored HB 253 (2026), which expands the Veterans Dental Care Grant Program for veterans not eligible for VA dental benefits; the House passed it 116-0 in March 2026.

record.item: Voted no on HB 1 (2023), SB 300 (2023) and HB 543 (2023). Recorded as not voting on HJR 1-F (2026), HJR 203 (2026) and SB 2-C (2025). Sponsored HB 253 (2026, veterans dental care).
